svg.title: Ambient arc motif
svg.desc: Concentric contour rings. Anchor OFF-CANVAS at top-right or bottom-left so only arcs enter the frame, never a whole circle. Radii step irregularly and tighten toward the outer edge — evenly spaced rings read as a target, not an orbit. Stroke #0E2E5C at 12-20% effective opacity. Always behind content. Max two anchors per surface.
